tagline: 柯尼卡胶片单反相机，2000 年发布
description: 柯尼卡于2000年推出的胶片单反相机。配备Konica 28-70mm zoom. Max. aperture f/3.4-7.9. Six elements in six groups.。快门速度1.3-1/500s.。使用Auto-load, wind and rewind. Manual rewind also available.。感光度ISO 25-3200 via DX Encoding.。

specs.镜头: Konica 28-70mm zoom. Max. aperture f/3.4-7.9. Six elements in six groups.
specs.闪光灯: Automatic flashmatic system for correct power. Operating range at 28mm focal length is 0.7-5.4m at ISO 100. 0.7-2.3m at 70mm. 5 second recharge.
specs.胶片/画幅: Auto-load, wind and rewind. Manual rewind also available.
specs.英文简介: The Lexio 70, introduced in 2000 by Konica, is a very compact Zoom lensed camera with an impressive specification.
